title: calculateTotal ignored in all query handlers — total always returned
description: RFC 8620 §5.5: 'total MUST be omitted if the calculateTotal request argument is false' (default: false). All three query handlers (handle_mailbox_query, handle_email_query, handle_submission_query) never read calculateTotal from args and always include 'total' in the response. For mailbox_query, total is always computed. Trigger: any /query call without calculateTotal=true → total is returned when it must be omitted.
